top.title: Houthis anunciam ataques contra Arábia Saudita após ofensiva do governo do Iêmen
top.summary: Imagens de drones mostram ataques contra veículos e tropas na rodovia costeira sul, perto de Al Bahiya, província de Lahij, no Iêmen Mídia militar Houthis / Divulgação Os Houthis, grupo extremista do Iêmen apoiado pelo Irã, anunciaram uma série de ataques contra a Arábia Saudita nesta segunda-feira (5). O porta-voz dos rebeldes ienamitas afirmou que o aeroporto internacional da capital saudita, Riad, uma refinaria da Aramco e locais em todo o sul do reino saudita foram atingidos. Os ataques…

articles.title: Yemen government forces announce offensive on Houthi-held territory
articles.summary: The internationally recognised Yemeni government announced on Sunday the launch of an offensive ‌to recapture territory held by Houthi rebels, with President Rashad al-Alimi swearing to fight "until the country is liberated from the grip of the terrorist militia".

articles.title: Yemen's government declares major operation against Houthis
articles.summary: The Yemeni military announced a broad set of strikes against Houthi targets on Monday, after the government declared a new campaign to retake all territory even as the Iran-backed group made fresh gains on the ground. France 24's Kethevane Gorjestani takes a look at the reasons behind this latest escalation in the long-running conflict.

articles.title: Yemeni government forces attack Houthi positions near Bab el-Mandeb
Yemeni government forces claim over 1,120 attacks against Houthi positions
articles.summary: The spokesperson for Yemen’s government-aligned forces said that 1,122 attacks were carried out against Houthi targets, claiming that around 1,747 of the group's fighters were killed. Majid Abdullah Al-Nuzaili indicated that the operations took place in Saada, al-Jawf, Taiz and the country’s coast, and were conducted using warplanes, drones, missiles, rockets, artillery and snipers. He added that 364 military vehicles, equipment and transport and supply means belonging to the Houthis were…
